content.page_summary: Reference list entries (892-899) from a cardiomyopathy/cardiac guidelines document, citing position papers and guidelines on phenotype-genotype nomenclature, cardiac involvement in vasculitis, definitions and management of dilated and hypertrophic cardiomyopathies, heart failure in cardiomyopathies, genotype-phenotype roadmaps, and genetic evaluation practice guidelines.
